system.description: The life force of a demon preserved in vitriol. Minimum Degree equals the demon's circle; difficulty equals the demon's Essence. Immerse the demon in pure vitriol for five days, separating its life force from dissolving tissue. Success creates a palm-sized vial of living fluid. Failure kills the demon uselessly; botch frees it. If ingested, provides motes equal to (Essence × Willpower) after one hour digestion. Creates euphoria imposing -1 internal penalty per undigested dose. Roll Perception+Integrity vs. demon's Essence to glean memories. Cannot be split; largest mass survives separation.
